odia: ଘରେ ଗୋଡ଼ ନ ଦେଉଣୁ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଚାଳ ବାଜିବା
title: The roof before the first step
literal_meaning: Before setting foot in the house, the roof strikes the head.
explanation: The obstacle arrives before entry has even been completed. The dictionary gives beginning a task as the figurative sense of stepping into a house. Our reading follows that timing: a difficulty meets an undertaking at its start. The line does not identify a particular failure, blame someone for it, or say whether the work will eventually succeed.
meaning_odia: ଘରେ ପାଦ ରଖିବା ଆଗରୁ ହିଁ ବାଧା ଆସିଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଘରେ ଗୋଡ଼ ଦେବାର ଲକ୍ଷଣାର୍ଥ କୌଣସି କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହି ସମୟକୁ ଧରେ: କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଅସୁବିଧା ସାମ୍ନାକୁ ଆସୁଛି। ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବିଫଳତା ଚିହ୍ନାଏନାହିଁ, କାହାକୁ ଦୋଷ ଦିଏନାହିଁ, କିମ୍ବା ଶେଷରେ କାମ ସଫଳ ହେବ କି ନାହିଁ କହେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading notices trouble at the beginning, without deciding the ending.
odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଆରମ୍ଭର ବାଧା ଦେଖେ, ଶେଷ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଘର ଖୋଲିବାକୁ ଯାଇ ଦଳଟି ତାଲିକାରେ ଭୁଲ ଦେଖିଲା। ସେମାନେ କାମ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ବଦଳରେ ତାଲିକାଟି ସୁଧାରିଲେ। / A group finds and corrects an error before opening a reading room. This outcome is invented.
cultural_context: Sense2 supplies the task-beginning connection. The roof image does not document an actual injury, construction defect or historical event; its application here is editorial.
